units: Minecraft torso model pixels, 16 per block; cosmetic geometry, not a manufactured product
user_request: Organize item-model improvement; completely redesign all backpacks because players rejected their appearance
review_rule: Show old and proposed appearance before approving the replacement, preserving the user's earlier before/after requirement
approval: Visual direction accepted; native B02 scenes inspected
requirements: Three distinctly readable silhouettes within one coherent expedition/technomagic family
Field: compact canvas roll-top, leather closures, canteen and bedroll
Expedition: taller weather flap, split pockets, map case and sample flask
Rift: dark soft cargo body in a faceted protective frame with a restrained contained anomaly core
Every strap, seam, pocket and clasp must have a visual purpose; avoid arbitrary repeated trim
Keep the models legible in ordinary Minecraft scale, not only close-up renders
Use one geometry source for worn appearance, inventory miniature and Blender review
Keep field/expedition/rift capacities 54/72/84, module rules, crafting and saved contents unchanged
Retain the separate back slot and all existing backpack inventory behavior
Check bare skin, standard armor, Magen, Kotomyaf, wide/slim arms and native animated poses before release
Check elytra interaction explicitly; an attractive static picture is not evidence of compatibility
Use unchanged known texture references and native geometry; no new painted PNG
No live server or owner-profile installation during the design review
review_outputs: Three proposed backpacks together on reference players
Equivalent old appearance from the same camera
Isolated views of all three new packs
Editable Blender scene and GLB exports
Full-pack native screenshots before replacement is released
not_implied: Decorative canteens, rolled bedding and anomaly core do not add new gameplay mechanics
Visual approval does not certify pose or clipping tests that have not run
This is an art redesign, not new storage balance or progression
